measurement.contrast: Contrast of the elements was determined using the maximum slope between any two density points (of the measured sensitometric curve)
measurement.density_note: green (magenta) density of the receiver is implied; status M / densitometer not stated
measurement.interimage_metric: Cg/Cb+g = contrast of the green-only exposure / contrast of the green record of the blue+green exposure. Higher ratio = more inhibition from the blue (causer) affecting the green (receiver).
measurement.speed_metric_table_III: Relative green sensitivity (Table III); method stated for multilayers: speed point +0.15 density units above Dmin normalized to the check

layers_ML_1.name: Protective overcoat and UV filter layer

multilayer_test.additives_not_quantified: Surfactants, coating aids, emulsion addenda, sequestrants, thickeners, lubricants, matte and tinting dyes were added to the appropriate layers as is common in the art.

variants.ML-1: base (comparative): IDIR-6 in L10/L11, CDIR-1 in red layers (and L10), no IEH
variants.ML-2: like ML-1 except IDIR-6 in Layers 10 and 11 replaced with IDIR-2 at 0.097 (equimolar to 0.076 IDIR-6 within 1% using RDKit MWs)
variants.ML-3: like ML-1 except IEH-A added to Layers 7 and 8 at 0.0012 (printed: 'corresponding to 0.8 mmol IEH-A to mole of silver in that layer')
variants.ML-4: like ML-2 except IEH-A added to Layers 7 and 8 at 0.0012

ieh_ratio_check.note: g/m2 reading gives ~0.94-0.96 mmol/mol, not 0.8; unexplained (would fit if silver were ~1.17x higher). Value kept as printed.

exposure_protocol.printed: These multilayer coatings were given a stepped exposure in one color record but only flashed (non-imagewise exposure) in the other two records and processed as described for the bilayer experiments.
exposure_protocol.stepped_record: causer: blue record (for B->G) or red record (for R->G)
exposure_protocol.flashed_records: the other two records, uniform non-imagewise flash; flash level / resulting receiver density NOT printed

multilayer_test.process: as for the bilayers: KODAK FLEXICOLOR (C-41), BJPA 1988 pp 196-198; no times printed
multilayer_test.interimage_metric: Take the causer step nearest density 1.5; dD = receiver (green) density at that step minus receiver density at the causer's no-exposure step. More negative = larger drop = more interimage.
